chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abi Basir, who said:
I heard Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying: "A man's hand and his two legs are cut in qisas."

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.تُقْطَعُ: are cut; a legal punishment is carried out

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about cutting the hand and legs in qisas?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning qisas, stating that a man's hand and both his legs are to be cut in retaliation. It belongs to the field of judicial rulings and reflects the application of retributive justice in Islamic law.
